metrics: per-field and total NLL per transition, model vs frequency baseline fitted on the training split (P(field | phase, down), add-0.5 smoothing)

win probability by simulation on 600 random PLAY records with both nflverse probabilities present, 256 rollouts each; log loss and Brier with a 95% game-bootstrap interval (1000 resamples) for ours, nflverse home_wp and nflverse vegas_home_wp on the same states, and paired differences

fourth-down plan on 300 sampled test fourth downs, 512 rollouts per action; field goals beyond the longest made in the training split plus 3 yards and punts inside the opponent's 30 are not simulated; agreement of the recommended action with the real coach on decisions not flagged too_close, also split by training support (low support: the recommended call made fewer than 10 times by coaches in comparable training states)
outcome_label: home result at end of regulation: 1 win, 0.5 tie, 0 loss
rule: each configuration (full config hash: data, model, training, evaluation, test and plan settings) preregisters its own plan in prereg/<hash>.json before it reads the test seasons, and scores them once; a second scoring of the same configuration needs allow_rescore=True and is recorded as such. Every preregistration in the work folder is kept and listed in results.json.
